description: This is a Java entity class representing a Merchant Store object, mapped to a database table. It contains fields for store details such as name, code, contact info, location, currency, language, and templates. It also includes mappings to related entities like Country, Zone, Language, and Currency, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: MerchantStore
classes.description: Represents an online merchant's store with properties such as name, code, contact info, location, currency, language, templates, and related entities like country and zone.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the primary key ID of the merchant store.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the primary key ID of the merchant store.

methods.name: getStorename
methods.description: Returns the store's name.

methods.name: setStorename
methods.description: Sets the store's name.

methods.name: getStorephone
methods.description: Returns the store's phone number.

methods.name: setStorephone
methods.description: Sets the store's phone number.

methods.name: getStoreaddress
methods.description: Returns the store's address.

methods.name: setStoreaddress
methods.description: Sets the store's address.

methods.name: getStorecity
methods.description: Returns the city where the store is located.

methods.name: setStorecity
methods.description: Sets the city where the store is located.

methods.name: getStorepostalcode
methods.description: Returns the postal code for the store.

methods.name: setStorepostalcode
methods.description: Sets the postal code for the store.

methods.name: getCountry
methods.description: Returns the country entity associated with the store.

methods.name: setCountry
methods.description: Associates a country entity with the store.

methods.name: getZone
methods.description: Returns the zone entity associated with the store.

methods.name: setZone

methods.name: getStorestateprovince
methods.description: Returns the state or province of the store.

methods.name: setStorestateprovince

methods.name: getCurrency
methods.description: Returns the currency used by the store.

methods.name: setCurrency

methods.name: getWeightunitcode
methods.description: Returns the weight measurement unit code.

methods.name: setWeightunitcode
methods.description: Sets the weight measurement unit code.

methods.name: getSeizeunitcode
methods.description: Returns the size measurement unit code.

methods.name: setSeizeunitcode
methods.description: Sets the size measurement unit code.

methods.name: getInBusinessSince
methods.description: Returns the date when the store started business, cloning the date object.

methods.name: setInBusinessSince
methods.description: Sets the date when the store started business.

methods.name: getDefaultLanguage
methods.description: Returns the default language of the store.

methods.name: setDefaultLanguage
methods.description: Sets the default language of the store.

methods.name: getLanguages
methods.description: Returns the list of supported languages for the store.

methods.name: setLanguages
methods.description: Sets the list of supported languages for the store.

methods.name: isUseCache
methods.description: Indicates whether cache is used.

methods.name: setUseCache
methods.description: Enables or disables cache usage.

methods.name: getStoreLogo
methods.description: Returns the store's logo image path or URL.

methods.name: setStoreLogo
methods.description: Sets the store's logo image path or URL.

methods.description: Returns the template name used for the store.

methods.name: setStoreTemplate
methods.description: Sets the template name for the store.

methods.name: getInvoiceTemplate
methods.description: Returns the invoice template name.

methods.name: setInvoiceTemplate
methods.description: Sets the invoice template name.

methods.name: getDomainName
methods.description: Returns the custom domain name for the store.

methods.name: setDomainName
methods.description: Sets the custom domain name for the store.

methods.name: getContinueshoppingurl
methods.description: Returns the URL used for 'continue shopping' feature.

methods.name: setContinueshoppingurl
methods.description: Sets the URL used for 'continue shopping' feature.

methods.name: getStoreEmailAddress
methods.description: Returns the store's contact email address.

methods.name: setStoreEmailAddress
methods.description: Sets the store's contact email address.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the unique code identifier for the store.

methods.name: setCode

methods.name: getDateBusinessSince

methods.name: setDateBusinessSince
methods.description: Sets the start date of the store's business period.

methods.description: Indicates if the currency format is national.

methods.name: setCurrencyFormatNational
